faq.q: How much does Sharifov & Associates charge?
faq.a: Sharifov & Associates publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Sharifov & Associates offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Sharifov & Associates does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Sharifov & Associates have offices?
faq.a: Sharifov & Associates publishes two offices, in Brooklyn and Hempstead. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Sharifov & Associates?
faq.a: Sharifov & Associates names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
